annotations.title: Find top institutions and authors on a research topic

description: Give a research topic as a keyword or OpenAlex topic ID. Returns one ranked row per institution or author with the most works on it, with ROR, ORCID, total works, citations, h-index, and newest papers on the topic. Data comes from OpenAlex. Pay per event on Apify: 0.006 USD per row.

countries.description: Two letter codes such as US or DE. Institution rows must be in one of these. Author rows come from works with an institution in one of these, and the author may be elsewhere.

from_year.description: Count works published from this year. Default 5 years before the current year.

institution_types.description: Any of education, healthcare, company, archive, nonprofit, government, facility, funder, other. Institution rows must be one of these. Author rows come from works with such an institution.

max_authors.description: Author rows per topic, up to 200. Default 25.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_institutions.description: Institution rows per topic, up to 200. Default 25.

openalex_api_key.description: Optional. Your own free key from openalex.org/settings/api, with its own 1 USD a day of OpenAlex usage. Without one, the run shares a 0.10 USD daily budget with everyone on its address and keyword search can be limited. Never stored or logged.

recent_papers.description: Newest papers on the topic to add to each row, 0 to 10. Default 3. 0 skips them and uses far less of the OpenAlex budget.

row_types.description: institutions, authors, or both. Default both.

search_scope.description: title_abstract (default): a keyword must be in the title or abstract. fulltext: also the full text where OpenAlex holds it, which matches more and less precisely. Ignored for topic IDs.

to_year.description: Count works published up to this year. Default no end.

topics.description: Keywords such as perovskite solar cells, or OpenAlex topic IDs such as T10247, up to 20. Each one gets its own ranked rows.

name: find_research_topic_institutions_authors
title: Find top institutions and authors on a research topic
